reply.caption: An inspiring instrumental ambient bed blending subtle traditional Ethiopian pentatonic motifs with acoustic guitar, soft woodwinds, and warm cinematic strings. The mood is noble and triumphant yet intimate, acting as a gentle, non-intrusive background texture under narration without any strong lead melody.

cues.note: Gentle acoustic guitar and soft string texture establish rhythmic momentum
Warm string swell adds triumphant brightness for the iconic victory
Texture thins to low, somber cello pads following the tragic accident
Opening acoustic motif returns, building into a proud orchestral finale
